lifecycle.heading: Publication
lifecycle.cannotPublish: This lesson cannot be published yet:
lifecycle.confirmDeleteBody: It disappears from the public site immediately. Nothing is erased — comments, saves and results keep pointing at it — and you can restore it as a draft. Type the slug to confirm.
lifecycle.confirmPublishBody: It becomes visible to everyone at /lessons/{slug}.

blockers.missingBody: It has no content — no sections have been written.
blockers.deleted: It has been withdrawn. Restore it first.

pages.title: Pages
pages.subtitle: Open and close public pages without a deploy.
pages.reverted: That did not save — put back as it was
pages.confirmCloseBody: Visitors get a maintenance page instead. It disappears from the navigation and the sitemap. You keep seeing it, with a banner.
pages.messageHint: Shown to visitors instead of the page. Leave empty for the default wording.
pages.alwaysOpen: Sign-in, the admin panel and personal profile pages have no switch on purpose — closing them would close the page that reopens them.
pages.neverEmpty: No pages are configured. That means nothing can be closed, not that everything is.

activity.title: Activity
activity.subtitle: {count} recorded events.
activity.piiWithheld: IP addresses and client details are withheld — they need the activity:read_pii permission.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Platform configuration. Changes apply without a deploy.
settings.readOnly: You can see this section but not change it — that needs the setting:update permission.
settings.conflict: Somebody changed {key} while this page was open. Reload to see their change before saving yours.
settings.envNote: Secrets and infrastructure live in environment variables, not here. This screen holds product configuration only.
settings.pagesNote: Opening and closing individual pages lives on its own screen, so there is only one answer to "is this page live".

general.siteName: Shown in the browser tab, on sharing cards and in the header.
general.siteDescription: Used as the default meta description.
general.defaultLocale: The language served when a visitor has expressed no preference.
general.contactEmail: Leave empty to show no contact address.
general.supportUrl: Leave empty to hide the support link.

features.registrationOpen: When off, the sign-up form is closed. Existing accounts can still sign in.
features.examsEnabled: When off, quizzes are hidden from the site. Results already recorded are kept.

content.lessonsPerPage: Applies to new page loads. Existing links keep working.
content.defaultDifficulty: Applied to a NEW lesson or quiz at creation. Records already saved keep the difficulty they were given.
content.defaultExamTimeLimitSeconds: 0 means no limit. Applied to new quizzes only — quizzes already created keep their own limit.
content.defaultPassMarkPercent: Applied to new quizzes only. Attempts already marked are not re-graded.
content.defaultMaxAttempts: 0 means unlimited. Applied to new quizzes only.

notifications.commentReply: The default for a new account. Each person can change their own.
notifications.weeklyDigest: Off by default: a digest nobody asked for is the fastest way to be marked as spam.
notifications.fromAddress: Leave empty to use the contact address from the General section.

security.sessionLifetimeDays: How long a signed-in session stays valid without signing in again.
security.rateLimitWindowMinutes: The window each of the limits below is counted over.
security.requireEmailVerification: When on, a new account must confirm its address before signing in.
security.allowedOAuthProviders: A provider can only be enabled once its credentials exist in the environment.

localization.offeredLocales: Where a language is OFFERED — the language switcher and the hreflang links. It does not take an already-published language offline; that is a routing change, not a setting.
localization.fallbackLocale: Used when a message is missing from the language being served.

settings.readOnlySecurity: You can see this section but not change it — that needs the setting:update_security permission.
settings.localeNote: The default language is set under General, and is currently {locale}. It is not repeated here: two places to change one value is how they end up disagreeing.

status.webPushHelp: Both VAPID keys must be set in the environment. Their values are never shown here.
status.googleOAuthHelp: Set GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET in the environment. Google cannot be enabled below until both are present.
status.cloudinaryHelp: Needed for the logo and sharing image once uploads land.

questions.note: Percent correct is out of the sittings that ANSWERED the question. A blank is counted as skipped, not as wrong — a question nobody reached is not a hard question.
